听到桂雏菊的称呼，无言一口真气卡在喉咙的位置，不上也不下的，差点把他给噎死。
眼睛虽然还是看在书本上，但是无言翻书的动作很明显缓了下来，无言没好气的对着桂雏菊说道：“你直接叫我无言吧，或者叫我言也可以，就是不要加一个君字，我们华国人都这样，所以听着很别扭。”
“哦？嗯，好像是这样，我也听说过华国人好像都是直接叫名字的，那么我直接叫你言吧，你也直接叫我雏菊就好了。”桂雏菊笑着对着无言说道，起初对无言的忿忿，此时已经被她全部放下，经过一阵相处之后，桂雏菊只觉得眼前的人其实很好相处。
无言无所谓的点了点头，两人都没有意识到，在岛国这里，直接叫对方的名字，只有非常熟悉的人才会这么做，比如朝夕相处的好朋友啊，从小一起长大的青梅竹马啊，或者是情侣啊之类的。
而这里，却是有着两个认识还不到一个小时，就直接叫唤名字的人存在。
毕竟，他们两人对称呼都是抱着无所谓的态度，无言是没在意，毕竟在自己的国家，直接叫名字的就算是仇人也是这样的，而雏菊是大大咧咧的，没有意识到，这一点，从原著中，她对第一次见面的绫崎飒直接喊‘飒君’就可以看出来了。
时间就在两人问问答答之中悄悄的流过，直到一个小时之后，无言总算是及时看完了最后一本书了。
回忆了一下记起来的内容，无言满意的点了点头，合起手中的书本，伸了一个懒腰。
雏菊见状不禁一愣。“你…你看完了？”
“嗯，看完了！而且就算没看完，也不打算看了，一个小时都已经过去了。”
雏菊闻言再次一愣，看了看墙上的表，赫然已经过去了一个小时。
不好意思的笑了笑，雏菊刚刚完全忘记了时间了，不过转眼间，她又疑惑了。
“你真看完了全部的书？全部哦！”虽然忘记了时间，但是和无言的交谈雏菊却是没有忘记，这一个小时，分明被她用来聊天了，而无言也是一边看书一边跟她聊天，原本没有意识到，但是现在，雏菊只觉得不可思议。
一个人，一边跟人聊天，一边看书，能够在一个小时之内，别人无言不知道，但是无言知道，桂雏菊肯定不相信。
“啊，全部无言好笑的看着一脸见鬼的桂雏菊，虽然刚才他的确是在一边聊天一边看书，要是换了以前…算了，不提以前了，现在有了‘完全记忆’能力之后，无言只需要瞄一眼就能够完全“你可不要骗人哦，待会要是考不过，你就要输给我了，虽然我没有想到要你做什么事。”对于自己跟无言聊天分散他看书的注意力，雏菊心中有点不好意思，刚才她也没注意到，要是无言把这当借口，她也认了。
但是无言偏偏说自己完成任务了，这让雏菊如何不起疑心呢。
“我知道你不相信，书就在这里，你抽题目问问不就知道了。”拍了拍自己的胸膛，无言一脸信心十足的说道。
撇了撇嘴，雏菊随手拿起一本书，随意的翻了几页，随意的问了几道题，然后，她原本故作不屑的神色，就变得有点震惊了起来。
一连五分钟，雏菊不断的变相抽考题目，却是被无言毫无欠缺的答了出来，渐渐的，雏菊的脸，开始麻木了起来。

放下书本，雏菊丧气的垂下了头。“我输了…”
“不是还没考吗？怎么认输了？”无言有点幸灾乐祸的说道，不仅仅是因为调戏二次元妹子很有新鲜感，更多的是因为雏菊输给他的那个条件。
带了点小脾气的扭过头去，雏菊不甘的说道：“你都全部“哦？现在相信我能考过了？”
“啊，信了，谁知道你是个天才，不，是个变态才对，一个小时无言苦笑的说道：“什么天才变态啊，我不过是记忆力好而已，这就算天才了？”
“记忆力好？这可不是一点点的好，而是超好，爆好，都快可以破世界记忆记录了，这还不算变态吗？”雏菊给了无言一个白眼，差点把无言给电倒了。

Hearing Gui Daiju's name, Wu Yan's breath got stuck in his throat, neither rising nor falling, and he almost choked to death.
Although his eyes were still on the book, Wu Yan's movement of turning the pages obviously slowed down. Wu Yan said angrily to Gui Daiju: "You can just call me Wu Yan, or you can call me Yan, just don't add the word "Jun". We Chinese are all like this, so it sounds awkward."
"Oh? Well, that seems to be the case. I've also heard that Chinese people seem to be called by their first names, so I'll just call you Yan, and you can just call me Daisy." Gui Daiju said to Wu Yan with a smile. Her initial anger towards Wu Yan had been put aside by her. After getting along for a while, Gui Daiju felt that the person in front of her was actually very easy to get along with.
They nodded indifferently. Neither of them realized that here in the island country, calling each other's name directly would only be done by people who are very familiar with each other, such as good friends who have been together day and night, childhood sweethearts who grew up together, or lovers.
But here, there are two people who have known each other for less than an hour and called each other by their names.
After all, both of them had an indifferent attitude towards addressing each other, and Wu Yan didn't care. After all, in their own country, even enemies are called by their first names, but Daisy was careless and didn't realize this. This can be seen from the original work, when she directly called Ayazaki Sa 'Sa-kun' when she met Ayazaki for the first time.
Time passed quietly as the two asked and answered questions, until an hour later, Wu Yan finally finished reading the last book in time.
After recalling what he had remembered, Wu Yan nodded with satisfaction, closed the book in his hand, and stretched.
Daisy couldn't help but be startled when she saw this. "You...have you finished reading?"
"Well, I've finished reading it! And even if I haven't finished it, I don't plan to read it. An hour has passed."
Daisy was startled again when she heard this. She looked at the clock on the wall and saw that an hour had passed.
Daisy smiled sheepishly, she had completely forgotten the time just now, but in the blink of an eye, she was confused again.
"Have you really read all the books? All of them!" Although she forgot the time, Daisy did not forget the conversation with Wu Yan. This hour was clearly used by her to chat, and Wu Yan also chatted with her while reading the book. She didn't realize it at first, but now, Daisy just felt incredible.
A person can chat with others and read a book at the same time. Within an hour, others can know Wu Yan, but if Wu Yan knows, Gui Daiju will definitely not believe it.
"Ah, all Wu Yan looked at Gui Daiju with a funny look on his face. Although he was indeed chatting and reading just now, if it were in the past... forget it, let's not mention the past. Now that he has the ability of 'complete memory', Wu Yan only needs to glance at it to be able to completely "Don't lie. If you fail the test later, you will lose to me, although I didn't expect to ask you to do anything. " Daisy felt a little embarrassed that she was chatting with Wu Yan and distracting him from reading. She didn't notice it just now. If Wu Yan took this as an excuse, she would admit it.
But Wu Yan just said that he had completed the task, which made Dai Dai not suspicious.
"I know you don't believe it. The book is right here. You will know if you ask the questions. "Patting his chest, Wuyan said with confidence.
Pouting her lips, Daisy picked up a book, flipped through a few pages, and asked a few questions. Then, her originally pretended disdain turned into a bit shocked.
For five minutes, Daisy kept asking test questions in disguise, but Wu Yan answered them flawlessly.Come, gradually, Daisy's face began to become numb.
Putting down the book, Daisy lowered her head in frustration. "I lost..."
"You haven't taken the exam yet? Why did you admit defeat?" Wu Yan said a little gloatingly, not only because teasing a two-dimensional girl was very fresh, but also because of the conditions under which Daisy lost to him.
Turning her head with a little temper, Daisy said unwillingly: "You are all "Oh? Now do you believe I can pass the exam? "
"Ah, I believe it. Who knew you were a genius? No, you were a pervert. He said with a wry smile for an hour without saying anything: "What kind of genius pervert? I just have a good memory. Does this count as a genius?" "
"Good memory? This is not just a little bit good, but super good, so good that it can almost break the world memory record. Isn't this considered abnormal?" Daisy gave Wu Yan a roll of her eyes, almost electrocuting Wu Yan.
